label: Mod HUD
description: Writes the shared mod HUD panel (three lines with icons, players need zz_modhud.pk3) from chat: !hud sets a line for everyone, !hudicons lists the icon tokens. Other plugins (Gun Game) draw on the panel without this one.

commands.name: hud
commands.description: Line 1-3 of the panel for everyone; icons as tokens such as {rl} {mh} {ra}. clear blanks the panel.

commands.name: hudicons
commands.description: Tells the caller every icon token next to its glyph.

cvars.label: Permission
cvars.description: Permission level for !hud and !hudicons. Read when the plugin loads.
